home.name: Wilfried Houinlindjonon
home.title: Full-stack Developer
home.description: Passionate full-stack web developer with 3+ years of experience. I work on both front-end (React, Next.js, Flutter) and back-end (Symfony, Node.js). Based in Abidjan, I build robust, modern and scalable digital products.

about.title: About me
about.intro: Hello, I'm Houinlindjonon Alain Wilfried, a passionate and creative full-stack developer.
about.paragraph1: I work on both front-end (React, Next.js, Vue.js, Flutter) and back-end (PHP, Symfony, MySQL, PostgreSQL). User-focused and creative, I build robust, modern and scalable digital products.
about.paragraph2: With 3+ years of experience in companies and as a freelancer, I've built web apps, mobile apps and SaaS platforms. I'm proficient with DevOps tools (Docker, Git, CI/CD) and agile methodologies (Scrum).
about.paragraph3: I am a resident of Ivory Coast, more precisely Abidjan, and I am able to offer you a pleasant, simple and optimized platform that will meet all your requirements, whether you are based in Ivory Coast or anywhere in the world.

skills.title: My skills
skills.frontendDesc: Modern, reactive and performant interfaces. From component to deployment.
skills.backendDesc: REST API, Doctrine ORM, MySQL & PostgreSQL.
skills.webDescription: As a web developer specialized in React.js and Next.js, I've built solid expertise in creating modern, responsive user interfaces. I'm passionate about web development and strive to deliver smooth, high-performance user experiences. With React.js, I can easily structure and manage my applications' state, while Next.js lets me build scalable applications with advanced features such as server-side rendering. I constantly keep up with the latest trends and best practices to deliver high-quality web solutions.
skills.backendDescription: Designing REST APIs with Symfony, managing relational databases with Doctrine ORM, JWT authentication, and layered architecture for robust, maintainable web applications.
skills.mobileDescription: As a passionate mobile developer, I specialize in Dart and Flutter as my language and framework of choice. With Flutter, I can create smooth and appealing user interfaces for mobile applications. I value Flutter's versatility, which lets me build cross-platform apps from a single codebase. Using Dart, I write clean and efficient code, making it easy to develop responsive, high-performance mobile applications. My goal is to build high-quality mobile apps using the latest trends and best practices, while delivering an exceptional user experience.
skills.designDescription: As an aspiring UI/UX designer, I'm curious and eager to explore the world of user interface design. I use Figma as my go-to tool to explore and experiment with creating designs. I'm open to learning best practices in design and user experience, so I can grow my skills in crafting appealing and functional interfaces. I'm excited to explore this field and collaborate with other professionals to create compelling user experiences. My goal is to develop my talent and contribute to building intuitive, enjoyable interfaces for users.

projects.title: My projects
projects.subtitle: Web, mobile and fullstack applications I've designed and built, both in companies and as a freelancer.

items.title: E-commerce Platform
items.description: Complete e-commerce platform with admin backoffice, AI chatbot, mobile money payments (Orange/Wave), monorepo architecture and REST API.
items.problem: Selling online in Côte d'Ivoire, where customers mostly buy over WhatsApp and pay with Mobile Money, without leaving out those who want a real storefront.
items.solution: A complete monorepo e-commerce platform: a customer storefront and an admin back-office (Next.js) on a Symfony REST API. An AI chatbot takes orders straight from WhatsApp and Telegram, and the guest checkout is built mobile-first. Orders are collected via Mobile Money (Orange Money, Wave) or cash on delivery.
items.role: Full-stack developer — monorepo architecture, Symfony API, Next.js front, chatbot and payment integration, and deployment.
features: Storefront + admin back-office in a single monorepo
AI sales chatbot on WhatsApp and Telegram
Orange Money, Wave and cash-on-delivery payments
Catalog, orders and customers managed from the admin

items.title: Pockii
items.description: Mobile budget management app in FCFA. Encrypted local database, French interface, income/expense tracking and long-term financial overview.
items.problem: Many people in the FCFA zone track their budget in their head or on paper and end up overdrawn before the month is out.
items.solution: A local-first mobile budgeting app built for FCFA users: ultra-fast expense entry, automatic 50/30/20 allocation and real-time remaining-budget tracking. All data stays on the phone in an encrypted database.
items.role: Mobile developer — product design, UX, Flutter/Riverpod architecture and the encrypted local database.
features: Real-time remaining budget and fast expense entry
Emergency fund with a goal and visual progress
Subscriptions and planned expenses with reminders
Fully offline data in an encrypted database (SQLCipher)

items.title: Modular CRM
items.description: Client management tool inspired by Pipedrive. Sales pipeline, prospect tracking, tasks, reminders and complete client profiles.
items.problem: B2B SMEs juggle spreadsheets and scattered tools to track contacts, deals and invoicing, with no clear view of their sales pipeline.
items.solution: A multi-tenant CRM inspired by Pipedrive, with a JWT-secured Symfony API documented in OpenAPI and a frontend monorepo (public site + admin back-office in Next.js). Each company gets its own isolated workspace, pipelines and SaaS billing.
items.role: Full-stack developer — data modeling, multi-tenant Symfony API, Next.js front and SaaS billing.
features: Contacts, companies and deals organized by pipeline
Multi-tenant workspaces with roles and members
SaaS billing: plans, subscriptions, quotas and payments
JWT-secured REST API, documented with OpenAPI

items.title: Event Assistant
items.description: Smart event tool. Participant check-in via QR code, timeline, interactive games, user reviews and admin configuration panel.
items.problem: At an event, keeping attendees engaged and smoothing check-in stays hard with paper or scattered tools.
items.solution: An event web app where attendees join by scanning a QR code, follow the live program, play a QR-code treasure hunt and leave feedback. An admin panel runs everything in real time.
items.role: Web developer — design, animated Next.js frontend (Framer Motion) and real-time Firebase/Firestore backend.
features: Attendee check-in and registration via QR code
Admin panel: teams, live game, announcements, display screen

items.title: Pixeasy
items.description: Rental management solution in Ivory Coast (formerly ImmoFacile). Landlord and tenant apps, mobile money payments, WhatsApp notifications, rent, receipts and contract management.
items.problem: In Côte d'Ivoire, landlords manage rent by hand (WhatsApp, notebooks) and lose time on reminders, oversights and receipts.
items.solution: A rental-management platform with landlord and tenant apps backed by a Symfony API: rent tracking, receipt and contract generation, and accounting. Sign-in via SMS OTP, Mobile Money payments, and reminders/notifications over WhatsApp.
items.role: Full-stack developer — Symfony API, Next.js web app, Flutter mobile app (tenant) and OTP/payment integrations.
features: Manage properties, units, leases and tenants
Rent tracking (paid / overdue) and PDF receipts
Mobile Money payments and accounting (charges, payouts)

items.title: WiASSUR Website
items.description: Insurance company showcase website. Modern interface with animations and subscription forms.
items.problem: An insurance company needed a modern online showcase to present its offers and capture subscription requests.
items.solution: A polished, animated marketing site (Next.js, Framer Motion, Tailwind) that presents the insurance products, with subscription and quote-request forms that route each prospect to the right policy.
items.role: Frontend developer — build, animations and forms for the marketing site.
features: Showcase of insurance products and coverage

items.title: Fintech App
items.description: Cross-platform mobile app for a fintech. Payment management, notifications and smooth user interface.
items.problem: Magma-tech needed a mobile app to let its users make payments and stay informed in real time.
items.solution: A fintech mobile app (Flutter) connected to Firebase, offering smooth payments, secure authentication and real-time push notifications to track activity.
items.role: Mobile developer — Flutter development, Firebase integration and notifications.

items.title: Magma Website
items.description: Fintech showcase and web platform. Presentation of money transfer and payment services.
items.problem: Magma-tech, a money-transfer fintech, needed a modern site to explain its service and build trust.
items.solution: A website (React, TypeScript, Tailwind) presenting Magma's money-transfer offering, with a clear, responsive design that highlights how simple and secure the service is.
items.role: Frontend developer — React/TypeScript build and responsive layout.

items.title: ADGroupe Website
items.description: Showcase website for the digital services company.
items.problem: A digital-services company wanted a professional showcase to present its offering and generate leads.
items.solution: A marketing site (React, JavaScript, CSS) presenting the company and its digital services, with a polished visual identity and a simple path to getting in touch.
items.role: Frontend developer — design and build of the marketing site.
features: Contact form and calls to action

items.title: Insurance Comparator
items.description: Insurance offer comparison platform. Filters by category (Auto, Health, Travel, Home) and real-time results.
items.problem: Comparing insurance offers (auto, health, travel, home) is tedious: customers have to contact each insurer separately.
items.solution: An online comparator (Vue.js) connected to a REST API that queries multiple offers and shows real-time results, letting users compare and pick the right plan in a few clicks.
items.role: Frontend developer — Vue.js interface and comparison-API integration.
features: Multi-line comparison: auto, health, travel, home
Connected to a pricing REST API

items.title: Church Management Platform
items.description: Web platform for managing members, events and finances of a religious community.
items.problem: A religious community managed its members, events and finances across scattered files, with no central tracking.
items.solution: A full-stack web platform (Next.js + Symfony API, MySQL) that centralizes member management, event organization and finance tracking for the community in a single tool.
items.role: Full-stack developer — Symfony API, Next.js front and data modeling.

items.title: Kizuna Pay
items.description: Online crowdfunding platform (GoFundMe-style) for Ivory Coast. Mobile Money payments (Orange, MTN, Wave) via JoonaPay, KYC, moderation and campaign types: emergency, education, weddings, nonprofit projects.
items.problem: In Côte d'Ivoire, running a fundraiser (emergency, wedding, community project) mostly happens through manual WhatsApp transfers, with no transparency or traceability.
items.solution: A GoFundMe-style online fundraising platform tailored to the Ivorian market: create category-based fundraisers and donate via Mobile Money (Orange, MTN, Wave) through JoonaPay, with identity verification (KYC), moderation and WhatsApp sharing. Available as a website and an installable PWA.
items.role: Full-stack developer — Symfony API, Next.js/PWA front, JoonaPay payment integration, KYC and moderation.
features: Create fundraisers by type (emergency, education, wedding, NGO, gift, sport)
Mobile Money donations (Orange, MTN, Wave) via JoonaPay
Payouts to beneficiaries and commission tracking
WhatsApp sharing and installable web app (PWA)
